items.title: CANTO: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
items.excerpt: CANTO tokenizes NURBS geometry directly and predicts physical fields without an input mesh. The authors demonstrate differentiable CAD-parameter optimization. First submitted September 29; revision October 1. Research results and benchmark improvements are author-reported.
items.query: neural operator surrogate CFD FEA engineering September October 2026

items.title: Dependable AI-Assisted Engineering: A Formal Framework for AI Participation and Assurance in Safety-Critical Workflows
items.excerpt: A 17-unit wing-spar workflow separates AI generation, deterministic checks, and human judgment. The generated CAD passed 23 checks, but insufficient mesh-convergence evidence prevented automatic acceptance of stress criteria. The author makes no system-safety, certification or productivity claim.

items.title: ReliCAD: From Uncertain LLM Generation to Reliable Parametric CAD Modeling
items.excerpt: ReliCAD converts natural-language requirements into structured design specifications, models geometric and topological dependencies, and invokes a CAD kernel through an agent API for construction and constraint solving. The framework targets reliability and preservation of design intent.

items.title: Progress Software Connects Enterprise Knowledge Across Business Systems with New Agentic RAG Capabilities
items.excerpt: Available release adds a native Teams app, Smart Agent for multistep retrieval and a WordPress ingestion plugin. Smart Agent uses native MCP access alongside indexed Knowledge Boxes and web sources. Progress says existing content and access controls carry forward without reindexing.

items.title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
items.excerpt: RuleEvolve maintains candidate coding rules, mutates them with an LLM, and evaluates variants with a judge. Authors report tests across two agent frameworks, four LLMs and three benchmarks. arXiv lists NeurIPS 2026 acceptance; performance claims remain author-reported.

items.title: Fastly Launches AI Firewall and AI Runtime Control to Secure and Scale AI

items.title: Mistral Large 4 enters public preview; open weights still forthcoming
items.excerpt: The October 6 changelog lists Mistral Large 4 public preview with multimodal MoE architecture and a 1M-token context, explicitly saying weights are coming soon. The linked model card lists 1.05T total and 52B active parameters; do not substitute conflicting secondary-source figures.

items.title: Introducing Beam: Reflection’s 501B open-weight model
items.excerpt: Reflection announced Beam, a sparse MoE with 501B total and 23B active parameters for coding and agents. Early access is limited; weights, report and artifacts are planned later in October under Apache 2.0. Benchmark and efficiency claims are self-reported.

items.title: New KPMG AI Pulse Survey: As AI maturity converges, leading organizations show what AI at scale requires
items.excerpt: KPMG surveyed 2,131 senior leaders in 20 countries. Average planned next-year AI investment was $210M versus $186M in Q1; 55% report a formal control layer, while 12% consistently assess value against cost. These are respondent reports, not audited causal ROI estimates.
items.query: enterprise AI spending September October 2026 report survey official

items.title: AI drives productivity, but CEOs struggle to turn gains into growth
items.excerpt: EY surveyed 1,200 CEOs in 21 countries online during August–September 2026. Half identify AI as the largest productivity contributor; 23% say gains are absorbed before reaching financial results. Only 16% report clear real-time ROI visibility. Findings are self-reported.
items.query: AI adoption ROI productivity workforce September October 2026 report survey

items.title: AI Benefits at Work Unevenly Distributed
items.excerpt: AJQS surveyed workers January 26–March 24, 2026. Among 7,845 AI-using US employees, 63% report faster work and 46% better quality; the full employee sample is 15,482. Gallup warns these are workers’ assessments. Usage is associated with job quality, without establishing causation.
items.query: AI adoption ROI productivity workforce September October 2026 report survey

items.title: Manufacturing AI Initiatives Face Governance and Workflow Integration Challenges

items.title: Scaling AI for measurable impact
items.excerpt: September 2026 report; exact publication day not shown. Online survey of 1,050 executives in Europe, the US and China during August 2026. It reports measurable financial impact for 74% of organizations with implemented AI, but only 13% scaled fully according to plan. Self-reported.

items.title: Autonomous Materials Exploration Integrates Automated Phase Identification and AI Agents Enhanced by Human Guidance

items.title: Building Better AI for Chemistry
items.source: University of Maryland Institute for Health Computing

items.title: Physics-grounded materials AI for reliable materials discovery
items.excerpt: A Perspective proposes PhysMat AI, organizing physical knowledge as priors, descriptors, constraints, verifiers and infrastructure within a discovery-and-validation loop. Examples include catalysis, solid electrolytes and hydrogen storage. This is a proposed framework, not a benchmarked deployment.
